text.tspan: Fast. When this resolves, look at the top card
of any opponent's Archive; then look at the
top card of your own Archive and choose to
leave it on top or move it to the bottom.
The Panoptic Concord, Intelligence made total:
to know a rival's next move a moment before
they make it is worth more, in the Concord's
reckoning, than any weapon the Mass could
